verdict.rationale: A framework with an affiliated hosting platform (the evidence references Vercel) could plausibly offer a public status page, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the pack documents a status page or incident history for that platform. Mentions of Vercel templates and deployment lock-in are about other topics and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can check a public status page and incident history for the framework's official hosting/deploy platform before relying on it in production
